AVN's EXIT call remains unexecuted (24,500 shares still held) — no new company news.

EFERT — no new news since yesterday's Q2 briefing; WATCH/re-evaluate-at-Q3 stance unchanged. AVN — no new company announcements; EXIT call unexecuted through 8 reviews now. actions.title: Avanceon — H1 report confirms swing to a real net loss; EXIT call now backed by hard numbers, still unexecuted
actions.detail: No new news since the Aug 28 H1/Q2 FY26 filing: consolidated H1 2026 revenue grew a healthy +34% YoY (Rs 7.04B) but the company swung from a Rs 168M profit to a Rs 260M NET LOSS (EPS −Rs 0.62 vs +Rs 0.38); Q2 alone the loss widened to Rs 317M (EPS −Rs 0.74) from a Rs 104M loss a year earlier. Standalone tells the same story (H1 swung from +Rs 136M profit to −Rs 66M loss). No dividend declared (NIL). Cause: admin/selling expenses up 45% YoY, far outpacing revenue growth, plus 'other income' that cushioned last year's profit (Rs 162M in H1 2025) collapsed to Rs 77M this year, exposing weak core operating economics. This is real, board-confirmed deterioration — not a rumor or a single bad line item. Now Rs 29.30, −35% on cost, still near the post-selloff lows. No further earnings catalyst is pending before Q3; there is no reason left to keep waiting. The Aug 25 EXIT call is unexecuted through 8 reviews now — recommend selling the entire position at market.
